scope: Static producer bytecode/native reader analysis; no vendor code or device execution

producer.legacy_layout: 12-byte SFDNABDWFTCA + native signed int DB length + DB + image (shipped Linux LE32)
producer.type100_layout: 12-byte 100TMFWFSTCA + native signed int image length + rewritten image + DB
producer.selection: AUTO retains type100 only when BASEFILE detects type100; explicit --type=100 forces it, other --type values choose legacy
producer.fast_mode: --mf sets Py_SetEncryptMode; distinct from --type envelope selector
producer.windows_boundary: EncryptFw Windows branch copies DB; Linux invokes Py_106. Do not assume every platform/host transforms identically
producer.safety: Do not import/run decompiled module: ctypes loader at top level; ClearTmpFile deletes sample.db/temp.db/temp.img
producer.decompilation_limit: Include/parser loops have decompiler control-flow artifacts; envelope selection/write order independently checked in bytecode

legacy_envelope.reader: libScript.so ExtraFirmware 0x11f44; independently same magic check CompoundFW 0x404460
legacy_envelope.correction: 12 non-NUL bytes; native literal includes a 13th NUL but comparison excludes it.

db_length.consumer_interpretation: uint32 allocation/read; later signed int arithmetic

database.form: XYZ_108-wrapped database, not assumed plaintext SQLite

image.form: separate image file subsequently opened via libFileSystem

legacy_envelope.checks: ExtraFirmware checks magic only; no reliable read-length/bounds validation before allocation. Independent reader should reject truncation/oversize.
legacy_envelope.not_fields: No chip/version field in this 16-byte envelope. Do not transplant ACTTEST0 or 100TMFWFSTCA layouts.
legacy_envelope.new_format: Neither inspected ExtraFirmware implementation recognizes 100TMFWFSTCA. Parent producer analysis contains distinct new-format branch.

database_transform.caller: GetFirmwareBin 0x1245c -> XYZ_108 0x1baa9 -> XYZ_107 0x1b120; OpenFirmware 0x125e4 writes resulting bytes then sqlite3_open and sqlite3_backup into :memory:
database_transform.reconstruction: On successful XYZ_107, XYZ_108 removes total0x800 overhead: concatenate [0x200,0x200+A), [0x600+A,0x600+A+B), [0x800+A+B,end), where A=(a+1)*512 and B=(b+1)*512. Then transforms concatenation via XYZ_062/XYZ_063.
database_transform.remaining_boundary: XYZ_107 performs additional certificate/key/device metadata checks and transformations. Primitives intentionally not expanded; reconstruction is not a standalone decryptor.
database_transform.chip_identity: GetChipId returns object+0xb0; DWARF labels it m_pChipID[512]. XYZ_107 fills this through transformed metadata, not an exposed chip-name field in outer header. No ATS3085L binding established.

file_extraction.call: ReadFileInFW 0x10ed8 dynamically resolves FSOpen, FatReadEncryptFile, FSClose in %slibFileSystem.so
file_extraction.open_arguments: FSOpen(2, extracted_img_path,0,0,0x40000000,0x500000,0); type2 selects CSysfs32 at libFileSystem0x27e31
file_extraction.read_arguments: FatReadEncryptFile(image_path, backslash, logical_offset, output, requested_length, logical_filename)
file_extraction.logical_blocks: 10MiB (0xa00000) blocks; ReadBlock opens path format backslash + %s~%d, e.g. \Launch.pyo~0. Format literal0x38265.
file_extraction.transform_dispatch: ReadBlock0x26d92 reads whole block; first15 bytes112233445566778899aabbccddeeff selects XYZ_121, otherwise XorEncrypt; zero transformation return means success.
file_extraction.optional_alignment: ReadFileInFW may zero-pad returned output to caller alignment. SaveBinFile requests10MiB chunks with alignment0.
file_extraction.remaining_boundary: FAT32/XOR branch independently decoded for shipped sample (43files). XYZ_121 remains unsupported.

compound_format_side_observation.reason_in_scope: Avoid confusing CompoundFW-produced format with legacy inner envelope; one function plus DWARF inspected.
compound_format_side_observation.semantics: 64-byte entries begin at64; payload starts atheader_size. Writer sets offsets/lengths, pads each payload length to512 (zero added when already aligned). Header/entry md5 fields remainzero in inspected function; name alone does not prove MD5 validation.
compound_format_side_observation.not_default_upgrade: No claim this compound format is current default innerupgrade.fw, raw NOR, or CoMi accepted container.

xor.semantics: signed32 length; each byte XOR 0x38; no size/header/trailer change; return0
xor.dispatch: ReadBlock0x26d92: first15 bytes112233445566778899aabbccddeeff -> XYZ_121; otherwise XorEncrypt at0x26f32

limits: No real CoMi production envelope acquired
DB XYZ_108 and per-file XYZ_121 not implemented
No matched BSP, ROM transfer, full NOR backup or restoration proved
